translated.evidence: collecting real-world natural data of different languages instead of translating from English data is of great importance, as culture and world knowledge are deeply rooted in authentic data; we engage native speakers from each of the selected countries to collect official exam papers along with their answers at the end of each educational level

native_annotators.evidence: we engage native speakers from each of the selected countries to collect official exam papers along with their answers; We would also like to thank the annotators from various linguistic and cultural backgrounds who collaborated to contribute to this unique multilingual dataset.

culturally_grounded.evidence: by gathering questions from official exams across multiple countries, the benchmark contains natural multilingual questions in different languages, which retain the social-cultural diversity of knowledge that may be essential for problem-solving; some existing multilingual benchmarks...that were created by translating original English datasets have been found to introduce an English-centric bias...This shows the importance of sourcing real data from various languages to represent their native cultural background

M3Exam.annotation_quality_notes: Multiple rounds of quality checks were conducted. Annotators checked OCR text, fixed errors, separated question text from answer options, input correct answers, included contextual background information, converted special formats (equations to LaTeX, bold text), and annotated image placeholders.
